description: Graylog 7.x monitoring dashboard for KDN Lab — metrics from native Prometheus exporter on port 9833

panels.title: Graylog NVMe disk used
panels.description: Dedicated filesystem for Graylog's journal and OpenSearch indexes. Watch this before it reaches the OpenSearch disk watermark.

panels.title: Graylog NVMe free space
panels.description: Available bytes on the dedicated Graylog filesystem.

panels.title: Graylog host root disk used
panels.description: Root filesystem usage. Live Graylog log data uses the separate NVMe filesystem.

panels.title: Journal discards (last hour)
panels.description: Messages discarded by the Graylog journal over the past hour.

panels.title: Disk use over time
panels.description: Compare Graylog's dedicated filesystem with the Graylog host's root filesystem.

panels.title: Journal backlog over time
panels.description: Uncommitted journal entries. A sustained increase can indicate that indexing is falling behind.

panels.title: Incoming messages by input
panels.description: Per-second message rate from Graylog's configured syslog and GELF inputs.

panels.title: JVM Memory — Heap vs Non-Heap Over Time
Failure queue depth
panels.description: Measured current failure queue size. This does not infer a historical scheduler failure count.
